title: Tax environment

CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of associated country, e.g. `USA` or `GBR`.

ValidityStartUtc.description: If specified, marks the start of the validity interval in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

ValidityEndUtc.description: If specified, marks the end of the validity interval in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

TaxationCodes.description: Codes of the `Taxation` that are used by this environment.

description: Tax environment represents set of `Taxation` together with optional validity interval.
